title: My reservations

sheet.title: Reserve & collect
sheet.priceNone: Price to be agreed in store
sheet.howItWorks: The store prepares the card and holds it for you for 48 hours (Sundays don't count). You pay in store when you collect: no payment in the app.
sheet.doneText: Show this code at the till:

cancelConfirm: Cancel the reservation? The card becomes available to others again.
empty: No reservations. Find a nearby store and reserve the cards you want: you collect and pay at the till.

store.entryHint: Cards reserved by customers to collect in store
store.pickupPrompt: Pickup code shown by the customer
store.cancelConfirm: Cancel this reservation? The customer will be notified.
store.noShowConfirm: Mark the reservation as not collected? The card becomes available again.
